items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Arch Joe was a trumpet player too, but he's not, you know, he could read the music, but he never had no lip hardly.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. Yeah. Who did Eddie work with? Eddie?

Well, he played with the man who got the union. What do you name him? Arch Joe. He played with him all the time. Arch Joe was a trumpet player too, but he's not, you know, he could read the music, but he never had no lip hardly. Arch Joe, he was the president of the union.
Did Al Wynn's work with Eddie Carnes? Yeah.
